page.overview:
Who is Slaying Mantis?

Slaying Mantis is a supporting villain, serving from Season 3 and onward.

He wears a large, imposing battlesuit that resembles a mantis. The suit is primarily green and white, further emphasizing the insect theme. The suit incorporates sharp, angular features, mimicking the mantis's appearance.

His membership in The Order indicates a willingness to engage in criminal activities. He aligns himself with powerful villains, showing his desire for power or profit. However, he was also seen attacking civilians without much known reason, implying he may be sadistic.

Slaying Mantis is shown as one of the members of The Order during a meeting where Machine Head takes control of the organization. Machine Head goes ranting about how to change The Order or give some suggestions, and Slaying Mantis raises his hand. It is shown that Machine head calls out his name, showing that he is aware of who Slaying Mantis is then proceeds to curse him out.
